notes.title: Play SUFFOCATE's Demo During Steam's Next Fest ! New patch released !
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42340957/83251f8da36ccba18256aa78b7ccab54b8eb62ae.jpg
SUFFOCATE, a survival horror game developed by Naughty Cow, will be available to demo during Steam's Next Fest this February 24.

SUFFOCATE first released a playable demo during last year's Halloween, allowing players to get a taste of the game's introductory story and explore the Lin family mansion and the mysterious Lian Hua Temple.
For the upcoming Steam Next Fest, the updated demo features enhanced cutscenes, utilizing motion capture technology to make character movements more natural and immersive. Additionally, a new explorable room called the "Tantric Room" has been added to the Lian Hua Temple. Players who choose the "Standard Mode" can enter the room and "take a closer look," offering an up-close experience of the cult rituals depicted in the game.

A demo of ￼SUFFOCATE will be available as part of Steam's Next Fest this February 24. If you're interested, please add it to your wishlist to receive the latest news, and join the official Discord to talk directly to the developers!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42340957/83ebeac625f9844061e8cdddc029db0c103ecaae.jpg
Demo Update

 Reduced the ghost’s patrol range slightly
 Reduced the ghost’s vision range slightly
 Adjusted positions of certain maps to make them more noticeable
 Marked the locations of three drawing tools on the map
 Changed the placement of drawing stylus to make it more visible
 Changed the placement of Ruyi GuanYin to make it more noticeable
 Prevented the possibility of jumping from the 2F atrium to the 1F
 Corrected the calendar’s date and month errors
 Fixed the Taiwanese 16-tile Mahjong tile count error
 Extended the ghost event in the eastern hallway on the 2F
 Added a more obvious hint for the 3F College Code puzzle


Thank you to all the players who tried the SUFFOCATE demo
❤️If you enjoyed the game, we would be so grateful if you could leave a "positive review" on the demo page. 
Your support helps boost our visibility and motivates us to keep going. Naughty Cow sincerely appreciates your encouragement!!
